reviews.text: I adopted my first two dogs, a Yorkie and a Cavalier King Charles Spaniel, from this establishment, which I highly recommend!

We spent 17 and a half years with our family Yorkshire Terrier.
A wonderful dog that everyone thought was cute, even those who didn't like Yorkies.
Very playful, we miss him terribly.
Thank you, Dog Club.

There is no tangible information about the puppies, breeder's name, age, and the price is not mentioned at any point, but if you want to meet a puppy, you are asked to reserve and pay 100 euros, of which you have absolutely no idea if you will be refunded if you do not take the puppy, a serious lack of transparency.

Thank you, Stéphanie, for our magnificent Maltipoo, whom we adopted thanks to your excellent advice. As a first-time dog buyer, you were very reassuring and helpful. Regarding the misleading comments: there are no dogs on display, and visits are by appointment only, with only one dog to meet at a time.

I adopted my little boy on May 30th, an adorable miniature poodle. I named him Hugo (because his brother, Chat, is named Victor).

I didn't follow the "B" rule this year. He's an adorable miniature poodle, completely house-trained very early. He has no separation anxiety and is very calm at home.

And he has a wonderful temperament.

And he's in excellent health!

Thank you to Stéphanie for her advice and trust.

Laurence
I went there for information; Allan is very welcoming and provides a good reception, giving you all the information you need.

Thank you so much for your 5 stars ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
The entire Dog Club team thanks you for your trust and support 🐾 …

Thank you so much for these 5 stars ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Your satisfaction is our greatest reward. The entire Dog Club team warmly thanks you for your trust 🐾 …

I adopted a Cavalier King Charles Spaniel a week ago, and I can already say that this puppy has received so much love from the very beginning! He has a very sweet temperament and isn't difficult at all! I highly recommend Dogclub to anyone who wants to welcome a little companion into their home!

I highly recommend Dog Club to anyone looking to adopt a dog 🫶🏻🐶

For the past few days, our little Daisy has been brightening our days, and I'm so happy to have her in my life. Charming and sweet, a true little Westie. ❤️

I wanted to thank Ms. Stéphanie from the bottom of my heart for her warm and attentive welcome.
All the puppies are cared for by lovely, passionate, professional people who are dedicated to animal welfare.

A big thank you also to the breeder for these beautiful puppies; all their hard work deserves recognition.

Finally, without the breeder and Dog Club, I would never have met a friend like Daisy, a friend with whom to share wonderful moments and, above all, to give back love 🩷

Thank you 🙏🏻
Rita Santos
